description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Poison 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Poison/Fire/Lightning, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Edgar (Poison, Fire, Lightning)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Edgar (Poison, Fire, Lightning)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Lightning/Poison Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire, Lightning or Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Edgar after using three Fire, Lightning or Poison abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Withering Shot+
description.text: Three single attacks (1.10 each) causes [Imperil Poison 10% (5s)], [Imperil Fire 10% (5s)] and [Imperil Lightning 10% (5s)]

description.name: Chainsaw+
description.text: Five single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Edgar
description.text: Grants [Machinist +30% Boost 2] and [Machinist Instant Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Attach Poison 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
